style.backgroundSystem: deep brick-red silk drape #8E3B2E alternating with pine-green matte panels #1F3D2E and ivory matte board #F5EFE3, thin champagne-gold ring accents
style.iconSystem: thin gold-line botanical sprigs and seal-frame tags in a single accent color
style.lightingSystem: warm soft studio key from the upper left, gentle falloff, controlled speculars on the gold band, soft contact shadows
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent chinese national-style premium lipstick visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep brick-red silk #8E3B2E, pine-green matte #1F3D2E, champagne gold metal #D9B36C and ivory matte board #F5EFE3; warm soft studio lighting with an upper-left key, gentle falloff and soft contact shadows; classic serif display typography used consistently; thin gold-line botanical and seal-frame tag style; clean high-end beauty photography mixed with minimal national-style infographic elements; stable upright tube presentation and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: upright tube as the stable hero subject; consistent slight 3/4 or straight-on scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte silk-textured backdrop with ivory matte board #F5EFE3 for infographic and scene shots
style.typography: classic serif display family used consistently for headlines and labels
